notes.title: Bossdome 0.3
notes.content: [p][b]- Added The Altarator to the Bossdome[/b][/p][list][*][p]This should be fun, it's more elaborate than the Bossdome Pillarhead fight[/p][/*][/list][p][b]- Added Steam achievements[/b][/p][p][b]- Enabled Steam Cloud[/b][/p][list][*][p]Finally, all is as it should be with Steam[/p][/*][/list][p][b]- Added secrets in the Bossdome preludes[/b][/p][p]- Disabled Rageweed in Bossdome ([i]trust me, having it makes it harder, specifically in phase 2 Altarator[/i]), and limited Pillar Fragments in Bossdome ([i]once again, yes, having more speed makes phase 2 Altarator track their targets and explode after a timeout, and reduced the ammo on the rocket launcher from 8 to 4[/p][p]- Added skin names[/p][p]- Changed Joe's unlock ([i]yes, again[/i]) to obtaining an "Eye Fixed the player being able to advance after killing only one of the Robots' Best Friends in the Inventor's Caves[/p][p]- Cut the Inventor's Caves in half (one might even say [i]halved[/i] it) with another staircase[/p][p]- Added an indicator to the current weapon icon[/p][p]- Removed all weapon momentum stop[/p][p]- Nerfed Sandstone Spider damage and HP[/p][p]- Fixed the persistence of some dialogue boxes between levels[/p][p]- Added an indicator of the gained Viarum and max HP after talking to the Father[/p][p]- Increased the health of normal bosses[/p][p]- Staggered achievement notifications[/p][p]- Changed the rain ambient sound of the Inventor's Caves to a dripping sound[/p][p]- Fixed alignment and timeout issues with TiN_kAAn's Rotating Shield, and buffed his jetpack[/p][p]- Slightly reduced fall damage[/p][p]- Reworked money VFX to actually look like round coins flying toward the player[/p][p]- Buffed Dawn's shotgun damage from 59 to 71[/p][p]- Fixed a visual bug where Christopher's taser bolts wouldn't go away[/p][p]- Fixed shock ticking while paused[/p][p]- Reworked Alex's pole to scale better with its own damage and always pass through walls[/p][p]- Added text above character selection to say a character's name and subtitle or unlock requirement[/p][p]- Weapons with only 1 ammo (now labeled as "Single Use") will not consume their visual bug with the gamemode selection after switching slots[/p][p]- Fixed most items being locked after switching slots[/p][p]- Fixed character and skin selections persisting after switching slots[/p][p]- Added level banners to Bossdome levels[/p][p]- Reduced the text scrambling of several text elements in Bossdome[/p][p]- Adjusted the other dropped characters behavior so the Dawn doesn't sprint to the left like crazy during the drop if you aren't playing as her[/p]

notes.title: Bossdome Patch 0.2
notes.content: [p]- Reworked Christopher's second weapon[/p][p]- Fixed the yellow and black striped texture on the elevator in the Abandones Oil Mines to repeat seamlessly[/p][p]- Gave gamemode selection a menu of its own[/p][p]- Changed the skin button to cycle all availible skins[/p][p]- Skin selection and character selection will now remember previous choices[/p][p]- Added preludes to Bossdome fights[/p][p]- Removed a hidden visual element that was causing lag on all Snowhenge levels[/p][p]- Added the run time to ending screens[/p]

notes.title: Bossdome 0.1
notes.content:
The Bossdome is an alternate gamemode that is unlocked by beating the standard gamemode on HARD difficulty. Its purpose is to make battles more boss-centered, reworking them to be the primary focus at all times. Currently, only Pillarhead has had a rework.

Other minor changes:

- Made the difficulty notations in the campaign menu consistent with the ones in achievement descriptions
- Reduced the size of an unnecessarily large audio file
- Made minor changes in campaign start UI, including adding back buttons

notes.title: Minor Update 1.1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed an error that would occur with the first campaign menu after switching slots
- Fixed another instance of dialog persisting between stages
- Prevented Asylum Keys from dropping in Dying Paradise, since they are useless at and beyond that point
- Increased the chance of the top layer of the Inventor's Caves generating to 50%
- Fixed in game timer not resetting between campaigns
- Fixed the artillery robots jumping too high in the intro cutscene
- Boots of the Mongrel no longer mention fall damage when playing as TiN_kAAn, since he takes none regardless
- Added interpolation highlights to weapon icon ammo bars
- Fixed a recent bug where the achievement "Force Pillarhead's artillery against him" was unobtainable
- Put a limit on the number of effects (damage numbers, burst FX, etc.) that can be in the world at a time
- Deprecated shadows, may remove entirely in the future

notes.title: March 2025 Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
- Made changes in difficulty more visible in the difficulty bar
- Overhauled movement and enemy/ally AI to be more efficient
- Added spreading to the forward machinegun and shotgun
- Added a maximum to the speed reduction that can be applied
- Added a character-specific item to increase shotgun pellets
- Rebalanced the Asylum Keys, having them increase item price
- Fixed a bug where the game would remember what the name of the last played difficulty but not the actual difficulty
- Removed bloated code
- Added damage numbers
- Partially spatialized sound system
- Disabled increasing natural spawn rate during boss events
- Changed the name of "EYE OF THE . . . ?" to "EYE OF THE [ Dw3Ll3R ]"
- Fixed a bug where entities using the idle behavior would drift away from their origin instead of patrolling a set area
- Fixed janky weapon icon animations
- Reworked The Altarator's laser attack
- Added item lore that can be accessed in interlude levels
- Added unique character dialog
- Rebalanced jetpack and detonator
- Prevented players from leaving interlude stages by jumping over The Father's wall
- The Bullet Worm now reduces reload cooldown slightly
- Fixed detonator weapon never inflicting shock
- Gave the detonator a unique shock method of chance to inflict shock to all targets or none instead of a chance for each target
- TiN_kAAn no longer wears a parachute during the drop cutscene, as he is already immune to fall damage
- Connected the bottom of the Abandoned Oil Mines by a tunnel
- Fixed some structures that would create situations in which items would be inaccessible
- Prevented crawlers' legs from getting too far away
- Overhauled rain effects
- Prevented some weapons from halting player movement
